questions.question: The marks obtained by 10 students in a test are 12, 15, 18, 20, 22, 25, 28, 30, 35 and 45. Calculate (i) the mean, and (ii) the standard deviation of the marks.
questions.knowledgeNote: Standard deviation is $\sqrt{\text{variance}}$; use divisor $N$ for complete data and $N-1$ when the data is a sample.
